O2.reason: source differs at O2: types/mbox.h pointer arrays typed long *, mbox_get.c casts to char *

notes: mbox_len, mbox_pos and mbox_get are matched; the three O0/O1 sources are identical, and O2 needed two changes to mbox_get (long * pointer arrays and casts): with char * the O2 build kept the else-branch stores in source order instead of hoisting the element loads. mbox_ith matches apart from callees outside the four functions. At O0 the only differences are the calls to the static helpers filesize and mbox_from_, which I declared rather than defined, so the call targets are undefined symbols instead of section references. At O1 and O2 gcc inlines filesize into mbox_ith (fstat call), which cannot match without writing filesize, out of scope under the brief; the frac values for mbox_ith therefore say nothing about its own body. Local declaration order was needed to reproduce the O0 stack slots, and the fallback is dat + size rather than end.
